info.name: Lucid - Onboarding & Activation
info.description: User onboarding (BVN/email verification, invite), new-user login, and activation progress. These three folders are a strict sequential chain -- authentication here logs in with the user just created by onboarding, and activation acts on that same freshly-authenticated user -- so they run together as one flow, in folder order.
